title: Gunny AR Ladder
subtitle: Starter vendor AR ladder. Weapons per level are fairly confident (CQ A1 → M4A1). All attachments Pending 0.5 verification (Oct 19).

tiers.label: Level 1
tiers.unlockRepSource: Fandom Gunny L1–L3 cumulative rep 0 / 670 / 2,110 (pre-0.4 table)
tiers.summary: Gunny is a starter vendor. Starter AR build: CQ A1 (buyable at R1). Ammo at R1 was SP / FMJ in 0.4. Note: the M4 most players spawn with cannot be bought from Gunny until Level 2 — do not build early progression around purchasing an M4. Weapon choice is fairly confident; attachments are Pending 0.5 verification (Oct 19).

tiers.unlockRepSource: R4 rep threshold unknown (Fandom only lists L1–L3).
tiers.summary: Level 4 splits into three empty tracks instead of one build: Vendor preset (off-the-shelf), Min-max (best stats per gun model), and Drip (style when the numbers are close). All tracks to be built after 0.5 (Oct 19). R4 rep threshold unknown.

tracks.label: Vendor preset
tracks.whenWorthIt: When you want an off-the-shelf gun that works without a parts chase.
tracks.notes: Off-the-shelf Gunny stock. The L403A1 is the 'cheat gun' in 0.4 info — strong enough unmodded that it often does not need a custom parts list. Confirm after 0.5.

weapon.name: L403A1
weapon.notes: Fairly confident 0.4 R4 AR pointer for the preset track. Unverified for 0.5.

tracks.label: Min-max
tracks.whenWorthIt: When you want the best stat sheet per gun model, not a generic parts picker.
tracks.notes: Best-stat builds delivered per gun model after 0.5 — not a live parts builder. Empty until the preview meta is known.

tracks.label: Drip
tracks.whenWorthIt: When the numbers are close enough that the choice comes down to looks.
tracks.notes: Style-first variants once min-max options are near parity. Empty placeholder for now.
